messages:
claire: Quick FYI — we'll run a weekly 'trim elevations' sweep starting Tue 9AM PT. Goal: remove stale admin grants, reconcile KMS grants, and validate justifications. I sketched a canary: prune 5 random owners in staging, run smoke via /internal/access-checker. Need objections or missing edgecases. @aj @dan :eyes:
aj: +1 from me. Can we ensure we skip svc accounts that have recent KMS activity? last use within 30d.
dan: Agree. Also we should capture any changes in audit logs with 1h granularity so we can revert quickly. Runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/entitlement-trim (draft)
claire: Good call. We'll add a step: 'capture sequence numbers' and export to S3 -> encrypted with internal-KMS. cc: @ops-bot for retention config
ops-bot: retention_policy set to 90d for /entitlement-trim/logs by @claire
mike: For KMS, check for ownerless grants: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner")'` - want a list of principals then cross-ref with last-used.
aj: Can we avoid blanket owner removal? prefer 'remove iam:roles/editor/admin' and replace with scoped roles. We'll have a 'notify-and-stale' period 7d.
claire: Yes — plan: canary -> notify -> 7d grace -> auto-schedule revocation. We'll also create a temporary bypass group 'entitlement-exempt' for infra tickets.
dan: What's the rollback? if smoke fails, reinstate from snapshot: `scripts/access-restore --from s3://entitlement-trim/snapshots/$(date +%s)`
mike: One more: audit logging. Ensure KMS grant changes emit structured audit event and include `change_request_id`. Otherwise our alerting can't tie back.
claire: I'll add that to the playbook. Anyone want to run the staging canary Thurs 11AM PT? @aj?
aj: I can. Ping me on 1:1 day before.
claire: thanks. Filing follow-ups: create PR for job, update runbook, post pre-sweep notification to #all-hands. :thumbsup:
